draft_text: Robustness to label noise was not evaluated; the reported experiments cover only seed-to-seed variation under the original labels.
revised_text: Robustness to label noise was not evaluated; the reported experiments cover only seed-to-seed variation under the original labels.
rationale: The package contains only exp1 (original labels, 5 seeds) with comparisons of mean F1 and seed spread. No perturbation/label-noise condition or robustness test is reported, so the claim that label-noise robustness was not evaluated is accurate.
